text_en: 1. Overall trend: The market staged a violent rebound throughout the day, with the Shanghai Composite Index up more than 2%, the Shenzhen Component Index up more than 4%, the ChiNext Index up more than 6%, and the STAR 50 Index surging 10%. Stocks showed a broad-based rise, with more than 4,600 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets in the green, and today's turnover exceeded 2 trillion yuan. As of the close, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 2.16%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 4.22%, and the ChiNext Index rose 6.4%. 2. Industry sectors: Precious metals, semiconductor chips, computing power hardware, innovative drugs and other sectors led the gains, while liquor, food and beverage, insurance, banking and other sectors bucked the trend and fell. 3. Hot concepts: Semiconductor chip stocks collectively surged, and ChinaAMC STAR Semiconductor ETF hit the 20cm limit-up. Many stocks including Piotech, Jiangfeng Electronics, NAURA Technology Group and JCET Group hit the limit-up. Computing power hardware stocks rebounded sharply, with Shennan Circuits, Jin'an Guoji, Huazheng New Material and Guanghe Technology hitting the limit-up.
